name: Night lights, worldwide (Black Marble, VIIRS on Suomi NPP, NASA GIBS)
description: The Earth at night: NASA's Black Marble, a cloud-free composite of a year of night-time passes by the VIIRS day/night band on Suomi NPP, rendered by NASA GIBS. City lights, roads, gas flares and fishing fleets; dark sea and empty land. A still picture (2016, with 2012 for comparison), not tonight's — a blackout or a new town is not in it. Off by default: chosen from the view bar as an imagery view, it covers the basemap.
